capabilities: Create new .xopp files from the ribbon, context menu, or command palette
Automatically export modified .xopp files to PDF
Open files for editing directly in Xournal++
Configure default page sizes, grid backgrounds, and colors for new notes
extras: Warns that PDFs sharing the exact name and location of a .xopp file are overwritten on export; documentation lives on an external site; development is supported via Ko-fi.
motivation: The author says they hope users find the plugin useful, but gives no specific reason for building it.
problem: Obsidian has no support for handwritten note-taking or working with external annotation apps like Xournal++.

relations.evidence: Xournal++ is an open-source, cross-platform note-taking application for digital, handwritten notes and PDF annotations.

summary: Bridge to Xournal++ that creates .xopp handwritten notes and auto-exports them to PDF for viewing inside the vault.
